Reviewer: AUD-SOL-F56-119, operator agent 119. Independent T4 restack-delta approval of F5's test-only slice, **not integrated recurring-release approval**. [Candidate scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/685)

### Evidence applicability and provenance
G09 reuses this model's F5 approval at `858d37165662ad83af7c380f5f57700fd3d47afa` only for its unchanged assertions; the sole owned-file delta since then is FR12's ten impersonal r5 string replacements, directly reviewed with every amount and assertion shape unchanged. The other three F5 specs remain byte-identical; current own diff is +2,958/-0, patch-id `d88942b5b1d24c51dfb854432d1ba89e176b665e`, identical to FR12. [Prior Sol verdict and original finding closure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/685#issuecomment-5975835233) [Reviewed FR12](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/b8c26b7f7e32ad01250d1a7955555497f1445832) [Current head](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/c5e282fbfa3e7fe6a5593949182e17c91a011738)

All 10 F5 first-parent restack merges since that approval reconstruct to their recorded trees with `git merge-tree --write-tree`, with **zero conflict-resolution hunks**; expanding to the composed F6 lineage gives 45 automatic/tree-exact stack merges. Current F6's entire since-approval delta equals F5's delta, patch-id `94c65f22f0c3e8fb7e417ebfdf9b00b0af33641d`; every inherited fee-runtime/API/fixture delta was reviewed, rather than treating source changes as unchanged evidence. [F5 history](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commits/c5e282fbfa3e7fe6a5593949182e17c91a011738) [Composed top](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/8cb7b2d4bee3bccb65596581f84bccf9227ffc4b)

R75 from `b644198b` to the composed top is clean (as-any -14; all other classes net zero); dependencies/policy match that base, and the inherited migration's only new edit adds nullable presentment-notice columns to its unreleased CREATE TABLE, preserving the documented OR-113-4 pending-prefix disposition. [Integrated inputs](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/8cb7b2d4bee3bccb65596581f84bccf9227ffc4b) [Migration disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/681#issuecomment-5976288593)

### Independent integrated evidence and release boundary
New audit-only exact-top probe, source `be1444d898a529b8098953c383086c9ba034ac0e` with sole parent `8cb7b2d4`, runs real settlement/orchestrator/ledger/lock/refund-dispute services: **117 pass / two outside-diff dependency failures**, including all 112 existing F5/F6 tests and five new passing controls for JPY minor-unit refund/netting, true page-two reversal adoption after key expiry, saved invoice cursor recovery, malformed second refund page fail-closed, and unchanged one-time dispute access. [Executed independent probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228991086/job/111514467950)

**R-DISPUTE-PAUSE remains a release prerequisite on the fees-only top:** a newly disputed recurring plan with no failed renewal retains `entitlement_active=true`, and won-dispute handling changes its status to `paid`; this tree has no subscription-pause call. The second observation alone does not prove restored access when access was already false. [Executed dependency cases](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228991086/job/111514467950) [Runtime boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/8cb7b2d4bee3bccb65596581f84bccf9227ffc4b/src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts#L948-L1094)

Under guide rule 9 this is routed to F4/recurring/dunning runtime owners, not an A/B against F5's unchanged tests; recommended default is **withhold recurring release** until the integrated runtime proves immediate billing pause/access end for any disputed plan charge, no automatic restoration, coach-controlled restart and matching client copy.

### C-685-1 — retained optional coverage gap
`test/s-fee-r4-money-protocol.spec.ts:788-807` still claims later-page reversal recovery while its candidate fixture contains only one reversal; a first-page-only implementation satisfies that case. Minimal fix: prepend a newer nonmatching same-transfer reversal, assert the second `starting_after`, and assert no additional money movement. The independent page-two probe passes the current runtime but does not alter this candidate's coverage gap. [Candidate case](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/c5e282fbfa3e7fe6a5593949182e17c91a011738/test/s-fee-r4-money-protocol.spec.ts#L788-L807) [Independent page-two execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228991086/job/111514467950)

### CI / landing
All seven required stacked-base contexts are successful at this exact head; all four F5 suites execute and pass. Main-only CodeQL, danger, banned casts and SBOM have not executed on this stacked base; duplicate cancelled readiness-comment failures are superseded by successful checks, not candidate regressions. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37225036953) [FR17 check evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/685#issuecomment-5983285638)

The inherited mutant workflow is deliberately red, **373 pass / 54 expected MUTANT failures**, not a green workflow; every failure is in the four named mutation blocks, and controls pass. [Inspected inherited probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37225776608)

Keep the current size assessment (2,958; 42 lines headroom), collapse/land fees as one only after all pieces' dual approval, re-prove collapsed-tree equality and run all main-required gates; simulated-provider evidence is not live Stripe, device or production acceptance.
